* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 February 2025: “'''Light Side:''' While Luke alone here, [Cloud City] Rebels are destiny, power, and forfeit +1. '''Dark Side:''' May not be converted. While Luke or Rey alone here, your Interrupts are destiny -1.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Cloud City: Lower Corridor (V)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Cloud City: Lower Corridor (V)]] (published 30 December 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Cloud City: Lower Corridor (LIGHT)”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Cloud City: Lower Corridor]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
